Definition: Retsin, the name of a Syrian and of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Rezin was king of Syria, who joined with Pekah against Ahaz, and Isaiah was sent to tell Ahaz, take heed and be quiet, fear not the two tails of smoking firebrands. A later Rezin is named among the Nethinim who returned from exile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Rezin's threat was smoke without fire, and Isaiah's word still stands for every king who fears the wrong enemy.
RelatedPeople: Rezin; Pekah, King of Israel; Isaiah; Ezra
